head: a52708aa5ec842a056c02e69163b9c0fb69748c7
scope: Native Legal portal enrollment: Argon2id credential with issuer=local:credential, Legal share-token validation, verification-token handoff to the existing sandbox email adapter.

native_path.application: AccountCredentials.sign_up_legal hashes with the native Argon2id hasher, creates the native email-verification proof and returns the raw proof token to the trusted Legal enrollment caller.
native_path.repository: PostgresAccountCredentials.sign_up_legal inserts user/account(issuer=local:credential)/principal and the native proof without a second mail outbox; the audit uses the existing invitation_credential_created action.
native_path.endpoint: POST /api/v1/account/legal-enrollment on the private Account API verifies the HS256 erpx-legal-enrollment JWT, checks the exact Legal share email/expiry/revocation/enabled/destruction state, and calls sign_up_legal.
native_path.transport: packages/native-sdk/src/session.ts allows the bounded /api/v1/account/legal-enrollment path; the private boundary allows it only on the exact Account host.
native_path.route: packages/feature-account/src/routes/api/legal-portal/enroll/route.ts now calls the native endpoint and sends the verification link through the existing sandbox email adapter. It no longer calls createAuth sign-up.
native_path.test_harness: tests/support/runtime-env.ts aligns process.env.BETTER_AUTH_SECRET with the fixture env secret so the native server verifies the Legal JWT.

evidence.enrollment: The invited Legal enrollment returns 200, creates usr_legal_<uuid> with emailVerified=false, no staff assignment, and the sandbox verification email contains the native /api/auth/verify-email link.
evidence.unverified_continuation: The unverified native sign-in returns 200 and the Legal continuation returns 403 LEGAL_EMAIL_UNVERIFIED.
evidence.remaining_failure: legal.test.ts fails after the verification link: the native verify response sets a new session token but the test's subsequent native get-session returns INVALID_SESSION_PROOF (central is undefined). The native verification/session device-cookie handoff still needs correction.
evidence.support: support.package-surfaces.integration 22/22 after rebuilding the Field held-provider example
evidence.checks: cargo check private-field-api/existing-business and files-scan-worker/field-push-worker pass; tests/config typecheck pass; catalogue 33 modules / 1011 suites

not_certified.reason: One Legal integration case remains on the native verify/session device-cookie handoff, and secondary TypeScript Legal views keep http/ssr partial. Legal is not owner 5/41.

next: Fix the native verify-link session/device-cookie handoff (the verify response must expose the exact device proof the native get-session needs), then rerun legal.legal.integration to 52/52, migrate the secondary TS views and certify Legal.
